answer: An operator running 141 keys therefore forfeits for 141 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the quill salt is published after the lantern checkpoint, the walnut audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 236 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
